efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: CuztomBuildz
negative_reviews.text: Food was honestly severly underwhelming, none of it tasted authentic within a mile stretch and the portion sizes were inadequate , for the price, i expected to get atleast either flavour or amount and unfortunately i got neither, service was also fairly poor, staff who were unenthusiastic and clearly tired passively, the atmosphere was great, i cant say i didnt enjoy my time however i will probably not be returning anytime soon.
